summary.root_cause_text: The database is read-only ('attempt to write a readonly database'). This makes POST /orders fail with 500 and the ledger sync fail. The cause of the read-only state is unknown and no available tool can fix it.
recommended: A human should check the DB file and volume: permissions, disk full or filesystem remounted read-only, and whether the storage failed over to a replica.
Restore write access to the DB.
Run check_invariants to confirm /orders succeeds and the ledger sync resumes.
Rolling back v1.3 is not recommended. It is unrelated by timing and would not change DB permissions.
Ask clients to retry the rejected orders.

args.summary: POST /orders is failing with 500 because the database rejects writes as read-only. The ledger sync is failing for the same reason. The cause is at the infrastructure or storage level, outside the config, worker and deploy tools I have, so I made no changes and am escalating to a human.
